title: Haye Hussain Nargaye Aada me hai shabbir Akela
body:
HAAYE HUSSAIN asws., ***3
NARGAYE AADA MEIN HAI SHABBIR asws., AKELA.
1. JALTI HUI QAAK PE ZEHRA sa., KA PISAR HAI.
JISM MEIN PAIWAST SABHI TEER O TABAR HAI.
QOON MEIN TAR HAAYE MUHAMMED KA JIGAR HAI.
DASHT MEIN SAR PEET KE ROTI RAHI ZEHRA sa., 2. TEER KABHI TEGH KABHI BARCHIYA’N KHAYI.
SANIYE ZEHRA sa., NE YEH FARYAAD SUNAYI.
KOI BHI IMDAD KO AATA NAHI BHAYI.
JAO MADAD KE LIYE ABBAS asws., QUDARA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. SEENA E SHABBIR PE BAITHA THA SITAMGAR.
JANIBE QAYYAM WO LEHRATA THA QANJAR.
HONTO’N PE ABBAS asws., THA JAARI LABE SHEH PAR.
KEHTA THA ABBAS asws. KA BIKHRA HUA LAASHA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. BHAYI KA SAR KAT-TE BEHAN DEKH RAHI HAI.
SATH MEIN BETI BHI KHADI DEKH RAHI HAI.
HAAYE RE BE DEEN KI KYA BE ADABI HAI.
KAAT-KE SAR SHIMR NE ZULFO’N SE UTHAYA.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. AIK ANGOOTHI KE LIYE ZILM WO DHAYAD.
KAATKE UNGLI DIL E ZEHRA sa., KO RULAYA.
SAR KO JUDA TAN SE KIYA LASHE KO LOOTA.
KEHKE YAHI ZULM BHI IS ZULM PE ROYA.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. ZAINAB sa., E DILGEER KE DIL PAR YEH ALAM HAI.
SHIMR la., KE HAATHO’N MEIN SARE SHAHE UMAM HAI.
ISSE BADA AUR BHI KYA KOI SITAM HAI.
DEKHKE BHAYI KO YEH ZAINAB sa., NE PUKARA… HAAYE HUSSAIN asws.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. SAIF HAI MAGHMOOM GHAME SHAHE HUDA MEIN.
AAJ KUMAIL ASGHARI WALE HAI AZA MEIN.
SANI E ZEHRA sa., BHI HAI MASROOF BUKA MEIN.
AAQRI DAM TAK YAHI ZAINAB sa., KA THA NAUHA.
